summary:
Iter 151 — Draft Room dynamic stat columns + 3-click sort + trade-block toggle + on-block megaphones. Static pytest 6/6 PASS, new live backend tests 4/5 PASS, Playwright E2E PASS for sort/headers/toggle/toast. ONE CRITICAL BACKEND BUG: stat-filter buckets DO change underlying category stats (G, A, +/-, ...) per bucket, but fantasy_points + games_played stay IDENTICAL across all 5 buckets because routes/teams.py calls calculate_fantasy_points(p, config) on the raw player doc (top-level FP) instead of merging the bucket dict in. This violates user-request #6 ('FP values for the same player must change across at least 3 of the 5 buckets').

Verified LIVE on https://dynasty-preview.preview.emergentagent.com/draft-room after admin login (admin@dynastydreams.com / Admin123!):
• Iter 150 critical bug (line 1066 openBuilder() no-args crash) is FIXED — propose-trade icon now calls openBuilder({ leagueId: activeLeagueCtx?.id, myTeam }).
• My Roster panel renders new column layout. Switching stat filter to Regular Season shows header columns: 'POS PLAYER  G A +/- PIM PPP SOG FP FP/G'. All 6 per-category sort buttons present (data-testid='draft-room-roster-sort-{goals,assists,plus_minus,penalty_minutes,power_play_points,shots}') + FP + FP/G sort buttons (count=2 because both skater and goalie sections have their own header).
• Goalies section: data-testid='draft-room-roster-goalies-header' present (count=1), data-testid='draft-room-roster-skaters' present, data-testid='draft-room-roster-goalies' present. Ice Breakers has 1 goalie (Sergei Bobrovsky verified via API).
• Sort 3-click cycle works without errors (clicked goals header 3x).
• Trade-block toggle: Ice Breakers (own team, 10 skaters + 1 goalie = 11 rows) — block_cnt=11 + trade_cnt=11. Clicking the Megaphone toggles aria-pressed from false→true→false. Sonner toast verified: 'Added Jack Eichel to your trade block'.
• FP column alignment OK — values line up under FP/FP/G headers in screenshot.
• Live backend: GET /api/teams/69e59b33cbd3fea02a914c7b/roster-truncated?stat_filter=regular returns 200 with shape { team_id, stat_filter, players: [...], scoring: { skater: ['goals','assists','points','plus_minus','penalty_minutes','power_play_goals','power_play_points','short_handed_goals','short_handed_points','game_winning_goals','shots'], goalie: ['wins','losses','overtime_losses','saves','goals_against','shots_against','shutouts','save_pct','goals_against_avg'] } }. Skater + goalie expected keys present. All 5 stat_filter values accepted. Per-player stats dict varies per bucket (Jack Eichel regular: G=23 A=13 PIM=7; playoffs: G=7 A=1 PIM=59; l7: G=2 A=9 PIM=38). BUT fantasy_points + games_played stay at 403.0 / 78 etc across all buckets.

Source-verified only (could not reproduce at runtime due to seed-data overlap):

• Draft Board on-block megaphones (data-testid='draft-room-block-icon-{teamAbbr}-{overall}'): 0 rendered because draft hasn't started (every cell shows '#N —'). The 1 pick-type trade-block item (team 69e59b33cbd3fea02a914c79 round 2) should light up the round-2 cell for that team — un-tested at runtime, source wiring matches static test.

critical.issue: fantasy_points and games_played are IDENTICAL across all 5 stat_filter buckets (season/regular/playoffs/l30/l7) even though the per-bucket category stats (goals, assists, points, plus_minus, etc.) DO change correctly. RCA in routes/teams.py lines 893–901: when calculate_fantasy_points is available, it's called with raw `p` (top-level fields), not with the bucket merged in. Also games_played falls through `_bucket_stat(p,'games_played')` which returns 0 if the bucket doesn't have it and then falls back to top-level. RESULT: Jack Eichel returns fp=403.0 gp=78 for ALL of regular/playoffs/l30/l7 even though playoffs goals=7 vs regular goals=23 vs l7 goals=2. Mitigation: replace `calculate_fantasy_points(p, config)` with `calculate_fantasy_points({**p, **cats}, config)` (compute cats first), and prefer bucket gp via `b.get('games_played')` before flat fallback. Re-seed must also write `games_played` into each stats.<bucket>.

rca of the issue: RCA — Bucketed FP not honored: /app/backend/routes/teams.py lines 890-905 builds the per-player response. Line 893-899: `if calculate_fantasy_points: fp = float(calculate_fantasy_points(p, config) or 0)` — the helper iterates over p['goals'], p['assists'], ... etc. (the TOP-LEVEL fields), but the bucket dict (`b = stats.get(stat_filter)`) is only consulted via `_bucket_stat` later for the `cats` dict. So FP is the season-FP regardless of stat_filter. Same goes for games_played at line 900 — `_bucket_stat(p, 'games_played')` returns 0 if the bucket doesn't have a games_played key, then falls back to top-level p['games_played'] (78). Reproduction: GET /api/teams/69e59b33cbd3fea02a914c7b/roster-truncated?stat_filter=playoffs vs ?stat_filter=l7 — Jack Eichel returns fp=403.0 gp=78 in BOTH despite goals=7 vs 2. Mitigation: compute cats FIRST, then `fp = float(calculate_fantasy_points({**p, **cats}, config) or 0)`; and `gp = int((b or {}).get('games_played') or p.get('games_played') or 0)`.
